name: Dinosaurs
description: The best-known dinosaurs and their world, from the first ones in the Triassic to the asteroid that ended their age.

checkpoints.name: Triassic
checkpoints.note: Life recovers from the worst mass extinction, and the first dinosaurs appear in a world of one supercontinent, Pangaea, which later breaks apart.

checkpoints.name: Jurassic
checkpoints.note: Long-necked giants and armoured plant-eaters spread over the land while Allosaurus hunts them and Archaeopteryx shows the link between dinosaurs and birds.

checkpoints.name: Cretaceous
checkpoints.note: Flowering plants appear and new dinosaurs spread. Tyrannosaurus, Triceratops and Quetzalcoatlus live in the last stage, while the continents drift apart.

checkpoints.name: The extinction
checkpoints.note: An asteroid strikes Mexico and the climate shifts, wiping out the dinosaurs on the land except the birds.
